name: @lilmgenius/win-hooks
longDescription: win-hooks scans the Claude Code and Codex plugins installed on a Windows machine and repairs the hooks that cannot run there: .sh scripts cmd.exe cannot execute, bare Unix commands and interpreters that do not resolve, UTF-8 BOMs, and backslash paths. It repairs at every session start and again whenever a plugin update reverts a fix, so plugins installed later are covered too.
